per_rule.rule: S_N must not be null because it functions as the table identifier and join key.
S_N must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty.
Every S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N.
Account_No must not be null.
Account_No must contain exactly 4 numeric characters.
Name must not be null.
Name should follow the preferred personal-name casing convention and should not be fully lowercase or fully uppercase, while allowing particles such as bin, binte, d/o, and s/o.
ID_No must not be null.
ID_No must follow the dominant confirmed format of one leading uppercase letter, followed by 7 digits, and one trailing uppercase letter.
Race must use the canonical values Chinese, Malay, or Indian.
Gender must use the canonical values Male or Female.
Age must be parseable as a numeric value.
Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive.
Age should be at least 13 for this customer service dataset.
Contact_No must not be null.

Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number using either local 8-digit format or a Singapore country-code form with prefix 65 or +65, and may contain only digits, spaces, hyphens, parentheses, or a leading plus sign.
Email must not be null.
Email must match a basic email structure with exactly one '@' and no whitespace.
Country must use the canonical value Singapore.
Street_Name must not be null.
Street_Name should follow the preferred title-like casing convention and should not be fully uppercase.
Postal_Code must not be null.
Postal_Code must contain exactly 6 digits.
Names containing the particles 'Bin' or 's/o' must have Gender = Male, and names containing 'Binte' or 'd/o' must have Gender = Female.
If Street_Name is populated, Postal_Code must also be populated.
When Country is Singapore, Postal_Code must be a 6-digit Singapore postal code.
For the same S_N, Cust_Bio_dirty.Account_No must match the Account_No recorded in Acc_Info_dirty.
For the same S_N, Cust_Bio_dirty.ID_No must match the ID recorded in Acc_Info_dirty.
For the same S_N, the customer name in Cust_Bio_dirty.Name should be consistent with Acc_Info_dirty.Full_Name after normalising case and spacing.
Account_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
ID_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
